scope: observed command catalogue, not capability or creative acceptance

commands.label: Create Path
commands.params: {anchors: [{x, y, in?: [x,y], out?: [x,y]}], closed?: bool, d?: SVG path data} → {id}

commands.label: Add Anchor (Pen)
commands.params: {id, x, y, in?: [x,y], out?: [x,y]} append to the end of the last open subpath

commands.label: Close Path
commands.params: {id, in?: [x,y] (handle into the first anchor), independent?: bool}

commands.label: Move Anchors
commands.params: {dx, dy} move direct-selected anchors (whole paths if fully selected)

commands.label: Move Direction Handle
commands.params: {id, subpath, anchor, which: "in"|"out", x, y, independent?: bool}

commands.label: Set Anchors
commands.params: {id, subpaths: [{anchors: [{x,y,in?,out?}], closed}]} replace a path's geometry

commands.label: Reverse Path Direction
commands.params: {ids?, reversed?: bool (true: every subpath runs counter-clockwise on screen, false: clockwise, the Attributes panel's Reverse Path Direction On / Off; omitted: flip each path)} the paths in ids or the selection (groups and compound paths: the paths inside), as one undo step → {changed: paths}

commands.label: Join
commands.params: {} join two open paths' nearest endpoints, or close a single open path

commands.label: Average…
commands.params: {axis?: "horizontal"|"vertical"|"both"}

commands.label: Convert Anchor Points
commands.params: {to: "corner"|"smooth"} (Control bar convert buttons)

commands.label: Remove Anchor Points
commands.params: {} delete direct-selected anchors

commands.label: Reshape
commands.params: {id, x, y, dx, dy, tol=3, radius?} Reshape tool: grab the path at (x, y) (adding an anchor there unless one is within tol) and drag it by (dx, dy); nearby anchors follow with a smooth falloff over radius (default: half the subpath's size)

commands.label: Add Anchor Point
commands.params: {id, subpath, segment, t: 0..1}

commands.label: Cut Path at Selected Anchor Points
Reorder
commands.params: {id, parent?: id (null = top level), index} drag-reorder in the Layers panel

commands.label: Pencil
commands.params: {points: [[x,y]…], fidelity?: pt (1.5), closed?, style?: "pencil"|"brush", fill?: bool, extend?: {id, end: "start"|"end"}} fit a freehand stroke → {id}

commands.label: Curvature
commands.params: {points: [{x, y, corner?}], closed?, id?} create (or with id: replace) a path curving through the points → {id}

commands.label: Delete Anchor Point
commands.params: {id, subpath, anchor} remove one anchor, re-fitting the curve

commands.label: Convert Anchor Point
commands.params: {id, subpath, anchor, to: "corner"|"smooth", x?, y?} (smooth with x/y: out handle there, in handle mirrored)

commands.label: Reshape Segment
commands.params: {id, subpath, segment, t, dx, dy} bend a segment so the point at t moves by (dx, dy)

commands.label: Split Path
commands.params: {id, subpath, segment, t} or {id, subpath, anchor}: closed paths open there, open paths become two → {ids}

commands.label: Knife
commands.params: {points: [[x,y]…]} cut closed shapes (selected, or all when nothing is selected) along the polyline → {ids}

commands.label: Eraser
commands.params: {points: [[x,y]…], size?: pt (10)} erase a round-brush stroke from paths (selected, or all) → {ids}

commands.label: Path Eraser
commands.params: {points: [[x,y]…], width?: pt (8)} erase the parts of selected paths under the drag → {ids}

commands.label: Smooth
commands.params: {points: [[x,y]…], radius?: pt (12), fidelity?: pt (2.5)} smooth selected paths near the drag → {ids, before, after}

commands.label: Join
commands.params: {points: [[x,y]…], tolerance?: pt (12)} join the open-path endpoints scrubbed over → {id}

commands.label: Blob Brush
commands.params: {points: [[x,y]…], size?: pt (10), merge?: true} filled brush shape, merged with touching same-colour blobs → {id}

commands.label: Fill Rule
commands.params: {rule: "nonZero"|"evenOdd", ids?} the fill rule of the paths and compound paths in ids or the selection (groups: those inside), as one undo step → {changed}
